text_block_list.text: One peaceful afternoon——

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ——Found you, Trainer-san!! Turbo, do it!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Aye-aye, cap'n! You! Hold still!
(Slip!)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Done! Wearable type, "Tracen Academy: A 
Great Place, Come Visit Once" signboard!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's a wearable signboard for the 
"Promoshun" Squad! I worked really hard 
sewing it together!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It is an academy promotional squad 
conceived by Turbo-san. Today is 
officially our day of activity.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Now we're all ready to go! "Promoshun" 
Squad, full steam aheaaad!

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser & Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Tra~cen Academy~, such a~ great~ place~♪ 
Come vi~sit at~ least~ once~♪♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Pfft... what kind of song is that? There's 
never a dull moment around you guys.

And so began the sudden "Promoshun" Squad 
campaign. Since there was no harm in it, I 
quietly tagged along to keep an eye on 
them...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Look at that shop's signboard!! It 
stands out way more than ours!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
So annoying~~!! Trainer, go knock down 
that sign!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Please hold. Considering the long term, it 
would be far more efficient to make our 
own signboard stand out even more.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, stand out... stand out... Maybe... 
make some... sound... or something...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: SOUND!!!! Leave it to Turboooo!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I brought 'em!!

text_block_list.name: Band in Mid-Live
text_block_list.text:
'Sup. We're playing music for a promotion, 
right? Sounds like fun, so we're happy to 
help out~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Uhhhh...? Wait, is this actually okay?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Playing music without permission is 
impermissible. However, in this 
situation...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Turbo-san. Where exactly did you bring 
these people from?

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
——And now, at the wildly exciting "Street 
Live Festival"! Are you all having a great 
time?!

text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
And what's this?! A horse girl band from 
none other than Tracen Academy is joining 
in on the fly!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yup, yup! We're the "Promoshun" Squad 
Band!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Vocals: Turbo! Vocals: Nature! Vocals: 
Ikuno! Vocals: Machitan!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All the other instruments: people we don't 
know! Signboard: Trainer! And the song is—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser & Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Tracen Academy is a Wonderful Place, Come 
Visit at Least Once"!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser & Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Tra~cen~ Academy~, such~ a won~der~ful~ 
place~♪ Come vi~sit~ us at~ least~ once~♪♪

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text:
Wahahaha! That's great! Tracen 
Academyyyyyy!!!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: What the heck is thisss?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It is quite fortunate that a stage was 
readily available for use. We can promote 
the academy with maximum efficiency this 
way.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Isn't your adaptability a bit too high?! 
Wait, Trainer, say something to—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You're totally getting into being a 
signboard?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Come on~, it's your turn, Nature! Sing, 
sing~♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hold on! You don't have to drag me into 
this!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nature! This is our job as the "PR" Squad! 
Everyone's waiting! Sing, sing, siiing!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Guh, all these eyes on me...! Damn it, is 
this my punishment for trying to be a 
bystander...?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, whatever! If it's come to this, I'm 
just gonna go all out!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature & Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Tra~cen~ Academy~, such~ a won~der~ful~ 
place~♪ Come vi~sit~ us at~ least~ once~♪♪

And so, the "PR" Squad's stage was a 
massive hit. They brilliantly succeeded in 
conveying how fun the academy is... maybe?
